scripts.lint: prettier --check . --log-level warn && eslint . --max-warnings=0 && pnpm -r lint:deps && node .github/scripts/check-env-example.mjs
scripts.prepare: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');try{const g=(a)=>cp.execFileSync('git',['rev-parse',a],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim();if(g('--git-dir')!==g('--git-common-dir')){console.log('[prepare] git worktree: bỏ qua lefthook install (hook dùng chung ở repo chính)');}else{cp.execSync('lefthook install',{stdio:'inherit'});}}catch(e){console.log('[prepare] bỏ qua cài git hook: '+String(e.message).split(String.fromCharCode(10))[0]);}"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres postgres-test valkey
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile --target runtime -t taskflow-api:dev . && docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t taskflow-web:dev .
